statement: The three classes that each cost a hosted release-proof cycle are closed statically: no-use-before-define (variables) is enabled in eslint with the existing 57-finding debt triaged (dangerous in-block TDZ fixed, safe module-hoisting annotated or restructured), and the sub-100ms real-timer test census is swept to injectable clocks/schedulers, so runner-only failures cannot hide behind green local runs.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Proven catchable: no-use-before-define ({functions:false, classes:false, variables:true}) flags the exact full-gate failure (query-executor-partition-delivery.js 369:32, run 32623687633) in milliseconds; the rule is absent from eslint.config.js. Repo-wide trial: 57 findings across 26 src files (top: admin-control-snapshot-membership-publication-reconcile 8, diagnostics/budget-timeout-accounting 7) - a mix of safe module-const hoisting and dangerous in-block TDZ; triage before enabling, ratchet if the safe class is kept. Timer census precedents: failure-detector-recovery.property (fixed, injectable clock), migration-recovery-trigger (fixed, injectable scheduler); grep class: real setTimeout/wait windows under 100ms in tests.

notes.loadStarvationCensus: 2026-08-23 certificate run on d5e18ea3f (local, 20-core, otherwise idle): test/solve/health.test.js rr-H subtest took 66.5s for work that runs in ~0.3s standalone (whole test process starved by full-corpus shard contention), tripping the next tap test timeout. Census scope should include load-starved fixed timeouts, not only sub-100ms real-timer windows; feeds the ci-vm-admission-baseline epic (the corpus violates its own resource envelope under full parallelism).
notes.certificateFlakeLedger: Retry-once certificate campaign on d5e18ea3f (2026-08-23, local 20-core): roll1 test/solve/health.test.js (rr-H subtest starved 66.5s vs 0.3s standalone; next tap test hit timeout); roll2 test/bootstrap/node-joining-service.test.js subtest 22 "retries bootstrap when seed request times out" (flips even standalone ~50/50 - mocked seed-timeout race leaking a real 10s timeout error); roll3 test/bootstrap/startup-convergence-gate.test.js "timeout should classify no-signal stalls explicitly" (the documented same-millisecond race). All standalone-classified; each is census scope. Hosted sibling: test/solve/historical-artifact-batch-v2.test.js timeout at 32s on 2-vCPU ci.yml (11s green locally). Hosted sibling #2: test/integration/managed-split-admission-reliability.integration.test.js on the v0.1.1 release run (126s hosted, "degraded publication evidence should settle" missed its window, defer/persist chain cascaded; 31/31 green locally).
